d:
Welcome to another episode of my Oceania Series as I continue my journey to visit every country in the world.
After exploring the Solomon Islands, I flew to Vanuatu, a small island nation in the South Pacific known for its incredible natural beauty and its location in one of the most earthquake prone regions on Earth.
Vanuatu has experienced some powerful earthquakes over the years, and the impact can still be seen in parts of the capital. During my first day here, I walked across the capital and explored the streets, local areas, and everyday life of Vanuatu.
